description: A terminal-inspired software engineering portfolio with static case studies, role-fit assessment, and one-hour meeting scheduling.
highlights: One-hour Google Calendar and Meet scheduling
Bot detection and rate limits for public actions
metaDescription: Henrique Krause's software engineering portfolio with static case studies, role-fit assessment, and one-hour Google Calendar and Google Meet scheduling.
name: cekrause/portfolio

sections.title: Product
paragraphs: This portfolio brings a professional profile, contact links, and selected software projects into one compact interface.
Project pages are static and indexable, with canonical metadata, structured data, sitemap entries, and social previews.

sections.title: What I built
paragraphs: Public repositories owned by the configured GitHub account opt in with a `.portfolio/project.json` record. The sync validates eligible records into a build-time snapshot.
The role-fit route uses the published project records as context, returns a concise plain-text assessment, and stores neither the submitted description nor the response.

Scheduling accepts a name, email, local whole-hour start, and time zone. It checks Google Calendar free/busy, creates a private one-hour Google Calendar event with a Google Meet conference request, sends the invitation, and notifies the owner through Resend.

sections.title: Engineering choices
paragraphs: Client Components are limited to interactive forms, while Node.js Route Handlers validate input before external requests.

BotID, signed anonymous sessions, strict body limits, and Redis-backed rate limits protect the public fit and scheduling actions. Scheduling uses Redis-backed locks and deterministic event IDs to serialize slots and replay retries without duplicate notifications.
The responsive layout supports desktop and narrow mobile screens, visible keyboard focus, safe-area insets, and system light and dark color schemes.

summary: This portfolio presents selected software projects as static, indexable case studies. Visitors can compare a role with the published experience and schedule a one-hour conversation.
